basic_info.description: Bright, Updated Ingleside Gem with Spacious Backyard.  Welcome to this beautifully updated and move-in ready 3-bedroom, 1-bath home in San Franciscos sought-after Ingleside neighborhood. Light-filled and freshly renovated, the home features a modern kitchen with new appliances, stylish finishes throughout, and a seamless blend of comfort and functionality. Enjoy the backyardperfect for entertaining or relaxing. Ideally situated just moments from the vibrant shops and dining along Ocean Avenue, including Whole Foods, and offering easy access to I-280 and public transit. A perfect blend of suburban charm and city convenience.
